assets.prompt: Edit this kindergarten vocabulary scene to create the matching contrasting scene for teaching UNDER versus ON. Preserve the EXACT same friendly orange tabby cat with its white muzzle/chest, orange stripes, round dark eyes, pink nose and curled tail, and the EXACT same wooden rectangular table with four thick straight legs, same tabletop shape, wood colours, dark outlines and clean painted cartoon style. Move ONLY the cat: it must now be SITTING ON TOP OF THE TABLE, above the tabletop, with its bottom and front paws clearly resting on the upper tabletop surface. The table is underneath the cat. Preserve the whole table and whole cat uncropped on a square canvas; adapt framing only enough to contain the cat on top. No cat below the tabletop, no second cat, no new objects, no text, letters, labels, arrows, icons, border or decorative marks. Unmistakable contact of cat paws and bottom with the top surface. Keep the original simple educational picture quality, identity, materials, ordinary cat anatomy and transparent background. This image will be shown alongside the source, which depicts the same cat UNDER the same table; the only teaching difference is the spatial relationship.
